about_short_description.short_description: Simplified Financial Solutions Company offers startups and SMEs financial management solutions.

identifier.value: SiFi Spend Management Platform

product.name: SiFi Spend Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for real-time tracking and management of company expenses, including customizable approval workflows and detailed spending analytics.

identifier.value: SiFi Corporate Cards

product.name: SiFi Corporate Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual corporate cards issued to employees with spending controls and limits, accepted globally wherever Mastercard is supported.

identifier.value: Automated Accounting

product.name: Automated Accounting
product.description: A solution that automates accounting processes by mapping transactions to accounts and exporting journal entries compatible with accounting software or ERP systems.

identifier.value: Expense Reimbursements

product.name: Expense Reimbursements
product.description: A process to simplify employee expense reimbursements by capturing receipts, submitting claims, and approving payments through the platform.

identifier.value: Payments and Transfers

product.name: Payments and Transfers
product.description: A service to automate payments to local suppliers and facilitate international transfers, simplifying accounts payable management.
